calibration_rule: Use already fixed common calibration configuration, no retuning from development or test effects.
confirmation_candidates: Remaining training sources only, with unchanged original 80/20 replication split and ordering. Pre-guard counts are upper bounds; no confirmation panel accepted by this stage.
gate: No graph, repair, prediction, utility, resource-family approval or semantic effect is authorized by this metadata inventory; passed fresh v4 model agreement validation and reviewed scope-bound execution required first.
heldout_rule: Original calibration and test remain source-disjoint; calibration locks fixed. Development effects must use a separately reserved whole-source test subset under the same one-tenth reserve salt; no other test labels inspected by development.
negative_branch: If v4 selection or fresh validation fails, preserve it. Do not retune, replace model calls or launch threshold-dependent effects. Complete scoped negative calibration reporting, existing theory and non-outcome engineering work.
post_guard_panel_rule: Select whole surviving reserved groups in the same fixed order, include entire boundary group; report a shortfall instead of drawing from confirmation. Freeze after the validated model threshold and training-side semantic guard.
source_semantics: Native non-community accounts are contributor proxies; unknown owners remain singleton units and never become genuine source-withdrawal requests.
